---
title: "Spotlight in a deck"
subtitle: "Hold the mouse button down"
description: "A RevealJS deck with the spotlight plugin enabled, so the spotlight can be tried with the mouse."
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: true
    spotlight:
      size: 90
      presentingCursor: "default"
revealjs-plugins:
  - spotlight
---

## Try it

Hold the mouse button down and move the pointer: the slide dims around it.

This deck sets a spotlight of 90 pixels, and keeps an ordinary cursor visible when the spotlight is off.

## Why it helps

- A room watching a projected slide cannot see a laser pointer on a stream.
- A recording keeps the spotlight, and keeps nothing of a laser.
- Nothing has to be drawn on the slide in advance.

## As a coloured pointer instead

Set `useAsPointer: true` and the plugin draws a coloured dot rather than dimming the slide, which suits a bright room better.
